title.en: The 4-Hour Proclamation: The Great Migrant Walking Exodus

flash.id: Keputusan Drastis: Lockdown 21 hari diumumkan dengan pemberitahuan 4 jam; jutaan pekerja berjalan kaki ratusan kilometer.
flash.en: Drastic Decree: A 21-day nationwide lockdown decreed with four hours' notice, stranding millions of daily-wage workers.

clinicalTarget.id: Pencegahan infeksi pedesaan, deteksi demam di perbatasan
clinicalTarget.en: Prevention of rural infiltration, border checkpoint fever scans

description.id: Pada 24 Maret 2020 pukul 20.00, Perdana Menteri Modi mengumumkan penguncian seluruh negara berpenduduk 1,3 miliar jiwa dalam tempo 4 jam. Sistem transportasi kereta api dan bus lumpuh seketika. Tanpa tabungan dan makanan di kota-kota metropolitan seperti Delhi dan Mumbai, jutaan pekerja harian berjalan kaki bersama keluarga mereka menempuh ratusan kilometer di bawah terik matahari.
description.en: On March 24, 2020 at 8 PM, a nationwide lockdown of 1.3 billion citizens was proclaimed with merely four hours' notice. All trains and buses ceased instantly. Deprived of wages and shelter in megacities like Delhi and Mumbai, millions of daily laborers began walking hundreds of kilometers across dusty highways toward their rural villages.

title.en: The Delta Tsunami: The Oxygen Grid Collapse

flash.id: Eskalasi Mematikan: 400.000 kasus baru per hari; tabung oksigen diperjualbelikan di pasar gelap; krematorium jalanan menyala malam hari.
flash.en: Lethal Escalation: 400,000 daily cases; black markets for oxygen cylinders; mass pyres illuminate night skies across cities.

mutationType.id: Mutasi Ganda L452R + T478K (Viral Load 1000x Lebih Tinggi)
mutationType.en: Dual Mutation L452R + T478K (1000x Higher Viral Load)

clinicalTarget.id: Kerusakan paru kilat dalam 3-5 hari, badai sitokin ekstrem
clinicalTarget.en: Rapid lung destruction in 3-5 days, explosive cytokine cascade

description.id: Musim semi 2021 menyaksikan lahirnya varian paling ganas dalam pandemi: Delta. Dengan kemampuan replikasi luar biasa cepat, varian ini menyapu India bagai badai api. Rumah sakit kehabisan pasokan oksigen medis dalam hitungan jam. Tagar Twitter #SOS menjadi saluran darurat warga mencari tabung oksigen, tempat tidur ICU, dan obat antivirus.
description.en: In the spring of 2021, the most catastrophic variant of the pandemic struck: Delta. Armed with explosive replication kinetics, Delta swept through India like a wildfire. Hospital liquid oxygen reserves were depleted within hours. Social media feeds transformed into desperate life-or-death boards pleading for oxygen cylinders and ICU beds.

title.id: Perisai 1 Miliar Dosis: Mobilisasi Terbesar Dunia
title.en: The Billion-Dose Shield: The World's Largest Mobilization

flash.id: Rekor Bersejarah: India melampaui 1 miliar dosis vaksinasi melalui platform digital CoWIN dan vaksinator keliling pedesaan.
flash.en: Historic Milestone: India administers its 1-billionth vaccine dose via the digital CoWIN system and barefoot rural vaccinators.

clinicalTarget.id: Perlindungan terhadap gejala berat dan kematian varian baru
clinicalTarget.en: Protection against severe disease and death from emerging variants

description.id: Bangkit dari abu tragedi gelombang kedua, Serum Institute of India di Pune memproduksi jutaan dosis Covishield (AstraZeneca) setiap hari. Melalui platform digital CoWIN dan dedikasi jutaan tenaga kesehatan ASHA yang mendaki pegunungan Himalaya dan menyeberangi sungai dengan kotak pendingin vaksin, India berhasil menyuntikkan 1 miliar dosis vaksin.
description.en: Rising from the ashes of the second wave, the Serum Institute of India in Pune ramped production of Covishield to tens of millions of doses weekly. Supported by the CoWIN digital logistics architecture and heroic grassroots ASHA healthcare workers who trekked across the Himalayas with vaccine iceboxes, India crossed the one-billion dose milestone.
